list.title: Automations
list.description: Prompts and commands Atd runs on its own: on a schedule, when files change in a folder, or after another automation.
list.emptyDescription: Have a prompt or a command run on a schedule, when files arrive in a folder, or after another automation finishes.
list.pauseDescription: Nothing starts on its own while this is on. Run now still works.
list.storeProblem: None of them run until they can be read. Saving an automation starts a new list and keeps the unreadable file beside it.
list.runProblem: Fix its problem to run it
list.runUnavailable: Automations can’t be read right now
list.deleteDescription: It stops running, and its run history is removed. Tasks it already started stay in your task history.
list.started: Run started; its task shows in the task panel.
list.startedMemory: Run started; its result shows in the run history.

status.pausedFailuresNotice: Atd turned this automation off after several failed runs in a row. Check its run history, then turn it on to try again.
status.pausedFinishedNotice: Its one-time run is done, so it’s turned off. Choose a new time and turn it on to run it again.

problem.invalidExpression: The custom schedule isn’t a valid cron expression.
problem.tooFrequent: Runs can’t be less than 15 minutes apart.
problem.unknownFolder: The watched folder is no longer available. Choose it again.
problem.unknownAutomation: The automation it follows no longer exists.
problem.chainLoop: Automations can’t follow each other in a loop.
problem.commandUnavailable: Its command was deleted, turned off, or needs input an automation can’t give.
problem.folderUnavailable: A folder it uses is no longer available.
problem.modelUnavailable: Its model isn’t available. Choose another model or connect its provider.

summary.monthlyLast: Monthly on the last day at {{time}}
summary.folderAny: When files are added to or change in {{folder}}
summary.folderGoneAdded: When files are added to a folder that’s no longer available
summary.folderGoneChanged: When files change in a folder that’s no longer available
summary.folderGoneAny: When files are added to or change in a folder that’s no longer available
summary.idle: Once a day, when the Mac has been idle for {{duration}}

trigger.title: When it runs
trigger.description: Runs start on their own while Atd is open.
trigger.previewError: Next run times couldn’t be checked: {{message}}

schedule.intervalNote: Counts from the last run, or from when it was turned on. From 15 minutes to 1 week.
schedule.dayNote: Days 29 to 31 aren’t offered because some months don’t have them. Choose Last day for the end of each month.
schedule.expressionNote: Five fields: minute, hour, day of the month, month and day of the week. Runs must be at least 15 minutes apart.

idle.note: Runs at most once a day: the first time this Mac has had no keyboard, mouse or trackpad input for this long while none of your tasks is running. Atd needs to be open, and a day without such a moment has no run. The time zone decides when each day begins.

folder.addedDescription: A new file appears in the folder.
folder.patternsNote: Separate patterns with commas, or leave this empty for every file. Hidden files and unfinished downloads never count.

failure.forbidden: {{name}} can’t be used: automations may not read your whole home folder or Atd’s own data.

delivered.title: Has a result
delivered.description: It finished with something to report.

nothingNew.title: Finds nothing new
nothingNew.description: It finished with nothing to report.

needsAttention.title: Needs you
needsAttention.description: It declined actions or left questions unanswered because nobody was there.

failed.title: Fails
failed.description: It failed or ran out of time.

action.title: What it does
action.description: Each run starts a new task in the task panel.
action.descriptionMemory: Runs work on your memory directly and don’t start a task.
action.promptPlaceholder: e.g. Summarize what arrived in my Downloads folder today and list anything that needs a reply.
action.promptNote: Each run starts fresh: say what to do, what a good result looks like, and when there’s nothing to report.
action.inputNote: The command’s input text. Folder runs also give it the files that changed.
action.consolidateNote: Merges duplicate memories and rewrites outdated ones, keeping their history. Memories it would remove become suggestions you confirm in Memory › Suggestions. While automatic learning is off, it changes nothing.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Runs happen without you, so choose what each one may do and read on its own.
permissions.notApplicable: Consolidation only works on your memory: it uses no tools, reads no folders and needs no approval, so these settings don’t apply.

policy.title: How it runs
policy.description: The model it uses, how long a run may take, and what happens to runs missed while Atd was closed.
policy.descriptionChain: The model it uses and how long a run may take.

tiers.manual: Nobody is there to approve, so every file change and terminal command is declined. Runs can still read and report.
tiers.auto: A model checks each action against this automation. Safe actions run; anything it would ask you about is declined.
tiers.always: Every action runs without asking, including terminal commands and files outside the task folder. Use only for automations you trust.

policy.commandTools: Runs use the command’s own tools.
policy.memoryDescription: Runs can use what Atd remembers about you. Automation runs never add to memory.
policy.foldersNote: Every run can read these folders. A watched folder is always included.
policy.noFolders: No extra folders. A watched folder is always readable.
policy.maxDurationNote: A run still going after this long is stopped and counts as failed.

missed.runOnce: Run once when Atd is back

missedNote.schedule: Runs missed while Atd was closed or the Mac was asleep. A catch-up run is marked late.
missedNote.folder: Changes made while Atd was closed. Skipping them starts watching from now.

delivery.title: Results
delivery.description: How finished runs reach you, and what the next run knows about them.

notes.whenNew: A run that finds nothing new stays quiet. Runs that fail or need you always notify.
notes.always: Every finished run notifies, with the opening of its result.
notes.never: Only runs that fail or need you notify.

delivery.previousDescription: Each run sees the last result, so it can report only what changed.

editor.label: Automation editor
editor.name: Name
editor.conflict: This automation changed since you opened it. Reload to continue from the latest version.

session.opened: Opened a new AI session in the task panel.
session.enableSkill: Enable {{name}} in Extensions → Skills before creating with AI.

validation.intervalRange: Choose an interval from 15 minutes to 1 week, in whole units.
validation.expressionRequired: Enter a cron expression with five fields.
validation.eventsRequired: Choose at least one kind of change.
validation.patternsInvalid: Use at most 10 patterns, each up to 100 characters.
validation.commandMissing: The command it ran no longer exists. Choose another one.
validation.commandNeedsPresence: This command reads the selection, the clipboard or a screenshot, so it can’t run without you.
validation.commandOff: This command is turned off. Turn it on in Commands to automate it.
validation.commandNeedsFiles: This command works on files, which only a folder trigger hands it. Choose Folder under When it runs, or another command.
validation.foldersUnavailable: A folder here is no longer available. Choose it again or remove it.

runs.label: Run history
runs.emptyDescription: Use Run now to try it out. Its runs appear here.
runs.openTaskFor: Open the task of the run from {{when}}

reason.overlap: The previous run was still going.
reason.missed: It was due while Atd was closed or the Mac was asleep, and missed runs are skipped.
reason.rateLimited: It had already run 12 times in the last hour.
reason.unsupportedFiles: None of its files could be given to the command.
reason.memoryPaused: Automatic learning is off, so memory wasn’t changed.
reason.commandUnavailable: Its command was gone, turned off, or needed input an automation can’t give.
reason.folderUnavailable: A folder it uses wasn’t available.
reason.agentReported: The agent reported that it couldn’t finish.
